title: rafkit: autocatalytic (RAF) sets in catalytic reaction networks
description: Maximal RAFs, strictly autocatalytic RAFs, irreducible-RAF sampling and census, exploitability, uninhibited RAFs (u-RAFs), and Gillespie simulation of catalytic reaction networks. Three binary-polymer generators: Kauffman's K-BPM with optional cleavage and generated inhibition; Serra & Villani's C-BPM, where catalysis follows active-site complementarity rather than a coin flip; and their firing-disk construction, which grows a chemistry closed under its own production instead of enumerating one. Hand-computed known-answer tests throughout, regression tests against CatReNet's own output on a committed fixture, and worked examples reproducing published results. Reads and writes the CRS interchange format and exports PNML.
